description:
Hi, 

 We are hiring for Retail operation manager for our client is into Pharma business. 30 days leaves once in a year. Salary is tax free (in hand) plus shared accomodation,food ,visa,tickets etc. 
 Role & responsibilities 
 JOB DESCRIPTION Retail Pharmacy Leader Company: Prince Farma
 Location: Angola
 Department: Retail Business
 Experience: Minimum 10-15 years
 Position Level: Senior Management / Leadership 1. Role Overview Prince Farma is looking for an experienced, commercially driven and entrepreneurial retail pharmacy leader to spearhead the development, establishment and expansion of its retail pharmacy chain in Angola. The position will have end-to-end responsibility for building and managing a profitable, scalable and customer-centric pharmacy retail business. The individual will lead the entire retail value chain, including business strategy, procurement and sourcing, category management, pricing, promotions, inventory management, store operations, new outlet expansion and customer experience. The ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of proven experience managing multi-outlet pharmacy retail operations, preferably with an established pharmacy chain. They should possess the ability to build a retail business from the ground up, establish robust systems and processes, drive commercial performance and lead teams across multiple locations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Retail Business Strategy & Commercial Management Develop and implement the overall retail pharmacy business strategy, aligned with the group's long-term vision. Drive revenue growth, profitability, market share and return on investment across the retail network. Develop annual budgets, business plans, sales forecasts and outlet-level targets. Establish business performance dashboards and monitor KPIs across all outlets. Identify opportunities to improve operating margins, productivity and cost efficiencies. Develop and execute strategies for scaling the retail network. B. Procurement, Sourcing & Vendor Management Lead centralised procurement and sourcing of pharmaceutical products, OTC medicines, dermocosmetics, baby care, wellness and other retail categories. Identify, evaluate and negotiate with local and international suppliers, distributors and manufacturers. Develop an optimal product assortment and category mix for different store formats. Negotiate commercial terms, purchase prices, credit periods, rebates, discounts and promotional support. Build strategic supplier partnerships to ensure product availability, competitive pricing and improved margins. Explore opportunities for private-label products and exclusive product partnerships. C. Pricing, Category Management & Promotions Develop the overall pricing strategy, ensuring competitiveness while maintaining targeted gross margins. Establish category-wise pricing structures, pricing guidelines and promotional calendars. Lead product assortment planning, range rationalisation and SKU productivity management. Develop seasonal campaigns, promotional offers, cross-selling and upselling initiatives. Drive loyalty programmes, customer retention and repeat-purchase initiatives. Monitor competitor pricing, product launches, promotions and market trends. D. Inventory & Supply Chain Management Establish robust inventory planning, replenishment and stock management systems. Ensure optimum stock levels across outlets, minimising stock-outs and overstocking. Drive inventory turns, working capital efficiency and stock availability. Establish systems for monitoring expiry dates, near-expiry products, slow-moving and non-moving inventory. Develop inter-store stock transfer and replenishment mechanisms. Ensure effective coordination between procurement, warehousing, distribution and individual outlets. Implement inventory controls and measures to minimise shrinkage, pilferage and stock losses. E. New Store Development & Expansion Identify and evaluate potential locations for new pharmacy outlets. Conduct feasibility studies, market assessments, competitor mapping and location profitability analysis. Lead negotiations for store leases and commercial agreements. Coordinate store design, layouts, fixtures, equipment, signage and merchandising. Drive the end-to-end process of setting up new outlets, including licensing, regulatory approvals, staffing, systems installation and launch. Develop standard operating procedures and a repeatable store-opening model. Ensure new stores achieve targeted sales and profitability within defined timelines. F. Retail Operations & Customer Experience Establish standard operating procedures and operational standards across all stores. Ensure consistent customer service, merchandising, store presentation and operational discipline. Develop a customer-centric retail culture focused on trust, convenience and professional healthcare advice. Implement customer engagement, loyalty and retention programmes. Monitor customer feedback and develop initiatives to improve customer satisfaction. Ensure compliance with pharmaceutical regulations, storage conditions, prescription handling and dispensing requirements. G. Technology, Systems & Process Excellence Lead implementation and optimisation of retail ERP, POS, inventory management and reporting systems. Establish integrated processes for purchasing, billing, stock control, pricing and financial reporting. Use data analytics to drive assortment decisions, sales productivity and inventory efficiency. Introduce automation and standardised processes to improve operational effectiveness. Develop outlet-level dashboards and management reporting systems. H. People & Leadership Build and lead a high-performing retail management team. Recruit, develop and retain store managers, pharmacists and retail personnel. Establish performance management systems, training programmes and incentive structures. Develop succession plans and a strong internal talent pipeline. Drive accountability, ownership and a performance-oriented retail culture. 3. Desired Candidate Profile & Experience Minimum 10-15 years of experience in organised pharmacy retail, with at least 10 years in multi-store pharmacy chain operations. Demonstrated experience in managing and scaling a retail pharmacy network. Strong exposure to pharmaceutical procurement, sourcing, category management and vendor negotiations. Proven track record in pricing strategy, promotional planning and gross margin improvement. Extensive experience in inventory management, stock optimisation and working capital management. Hands-on experience in identifying locations, establishing new outlets and managing store launches. Strong understanding of pharmacy retail operations, regulatory compliance and customer engagement. Experience implementing retail ERP, POS and inventory management systems. Demonstrated ability to manage P&L responsibility and deliver profitable growth. Educational Qualifications Degree in Pharmacy, Business Administration, Retail Management or a related discipline. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Business/Retail Management would be an advantage. A pharmacy qualification and appropriate professional registration would be an added advantage, particularly for overseeing pharmacy practice and regulatory compliance. 4. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities. Excellent commercial and financial acumen. Strong negotiation and vendor management skills. Analytical and data-driven decision-making. Entrepreneurial mindset and business-building capabilities. Strong leadership and people management skills. Customer-centric approach. Ability to operate in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The candidate will be evaluated against measurable business outcomes, including: Retail revenue growth and achievement of sales budgets. Gross margin and operating profitability. Same-store sales growth. New outlet openings against the expansion plan. Time taken for new stores to achieve break-even. Inventory turnover and working capital efficiency. Stock availability and reduction in stock-outs. Reduction in expiry-related losses and inventory shrinkage. Procurement savings and improvement in purchase margins. Customer satisfaction, loyalty programme penetration and repeat purchases. Employee productivity and store-level performance. Compliance with operational and regulatory standards. 6. What Success Looks Like The successful candidate will establish Prince Farma's retail pharmacy business as a professionally managed, commercially successful and scalable pharmacy chain. They will be responsible for creating the systems, processes, team and operating model required to expand the network sustainably, deliver an excellent customer experience and establish a differentiated position in the Angolan pharmacy retail market.
